description:
As an integration developer, you have just received a file named /home/user/api_responses.txt containing multiple lines, each representing a raw JSON response from a test API endpoint. Extract all values associated with the "id" key from every line and write them—one per line—into a new file located at /home/user/extracted_ids.txt. The output file should not contain any empty lines or extra whitespace. Each id value should appear in the same order as their respective lines in the input file. For example, if the first line contains {"id":12,"status":"ok"} and the second line contains {"id":42,"status":"fail"}, then /home/user/extracted_ids.txt must look exactly like:

12
42

Make sure the file contains only the id numbers, with no commas, spaces, or any other characters. If a line does not have an "id" key, skip that line and do not include any entry for it in the output file.
